methodological_disclaimer: The pipeline validation score evaluates automated data pipeline integrity, deterministic formatting constraints, aggregation consistency, and cryptographic file matching. It does not assert statistical sampling precision, representativeness, or absolute accuracy of the underlying MoSPI NSSO survey design.
